requirements.quote: The above work will not be further subcontracted without the express written permission of the contractor and notification of the Office.
requirements.text: Subcontracting requires written permission from the contractor and notification of the Office.

requirements.quote: The undersigned will enter into a formal agreement for the above work with the contractor ONLY upon the Contractor's execution of a contract with the Office.
requirements.text: Formal agreement with contractor depends on contractor's contract with the Office.

requirements.quote: This form is to be submitted with bid attached to the Subcontractor's Information Form in a sealed envelope for each certified Minority or Women-Owned Business enterprise the Bidder/Awardee/Contractor proposes to utilize as subcontractors, service providers or suppliers.
requirements.text: Submit form with bid in sealed envelope for each certified M/WBE subcontractor.

requirements.quote: If the MBE or WBE proposed for portion of this proposal/contract is part of a joint or other temporarily-formed business entity of independent business entities, the name and address of the joint venture or temporarily-formed business should be indicated.
requirements.text: Provide name and address of joint venture or temporary business entity for M/WBE.
